definitions.explanation: One's place of work or employment. The noun form of {勤|つと}める (to work at, to be employed). Refers to working for a company or organization.

examples.japanese: {父|ちち}は{銀行|ぎんこう}{勤|つと}めだ。
examples.english: My father works at a bank.

examples.japanese: {会社|かいしゃ}{勤|つと}めは{長|なが}いですか。
examples.english: Have you been working at the company long?

examples.japanese: {勤|つと}め{先|さき}に{電話|でんわ}してください。

notes:
USAGE: This kanji ({勤|つと}め) emphasizes employment at a company or organization. Different from {務|つと}め which emphasizes duty or responsibility.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・〜{勤|つと}め (working at ~): {銀行|ぎんこう}{勤|つと}め (bank employee), {会社|かいしゃ}{勤|つと}め (company employee)
・{勤|つと}め{先|さき} (workplace, employer)
・{勤|つと}め{人|にん} (office worker, salaried worker)
・お{勤|つと}め (polite: one's work)

CONTRAST WITH {務|つと}め:
・{勤|つと}め - focuses on employment, working for someone
・{務|つと}め - focuses on duty, obligation, role

Both are read つとめ but have different nuances.
